research_assumptions.policy: Expiry-amortized cost-aware ranking. Start fully in direct BTC; rank causal fee-adjusted futures returns against held KEEP returns without predetermined holding horizons.
research_assumptions.period: [2026-06-06T00:00:00, 2026-06-09T00:00:00) UTC; first three complete tape days.
research_assumptions.costs: 10 bp proportional fee on each simulated spot or futures fill; zero configured half-spread and additional slippage. The lease signal is separately discounted by the configured annual conservative-lease setting.
research_assumptions.execution: Adaptive source-first paired limits, 100 ms observation, decision and order-to-market delays, 100% participation in subsequent compatible prints, 0.01 BTC maximum instruction delta and unmatched exposure.
research_assumptions.limitations: Trade prints are not historical bid/ask or order-book depth. Binance BTC/USDT assumes USD parity and Deribit inverse prices are used as a USD-linear futures research proxy.
